# 2 Clement — Chapter 8 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 8
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. While we are still on earth, let us repent. For we are clay in the hands of the craftsman.
2. For just as the potter, when he is making a vessel and it warps or breaks in his hands, can reshape it again, but once he has put it into the fiery furnace he can no longer mend it — so also let us, while we are in this world, repent with our whole heart of the evil deeds we have done in the flesh, so that we may be saved by the Lord while we still have time for repentance.
3. For after we have gone out from this world we are no longer able either to confess there or to repent.
4. Therefore, brothers, if we do the will of the Father and keep the flesh pure and observe the commandments of the Lord, we shall receive eternal life.
5. For the Lord says in the Gospel: "If you did not guard what is small, who will give you what is great? For I tell you: the one who is faithful in very little is also faithful in much."
6. So this is what he means: keep the flesh pure and the seal unspotted, that we may receive eternal life.
